metrics.method: Full history 2025-09-16 → 2026-09-18, 1827 lines (1015 client msgs from 'Sarah H', 779 ALTR-side msgs across 17 senders, 33 service events). client_questions_total = client messages containing '?'. unanswered_over_24h = client questions with zero ALTR-side message of any kind in the following 24h (a lower bound: it counts a reply from anyone about anything as an answer, so real non-answers are higher). Median first ALTR message after a client question = 0.77h, mean 7.7h, p90 28.1h. max_team_silence_days = longest gap between consecutive ALTR-side messages (2026-03-19 → 2026-03-28), broken by the client. Promises = explicit dated commitments by ALTR staff to do a specific thing ('I'll send X', 'we'll have it by Y', 'let me check and get back to you'); hand-counted from a full read, kept = evidence of delivery in-chat, lapsed = no delivery and no further mention.
